auth_tokens_email_canonical.name: auth_tokens_email_canonical
auth_tokens_email_canonical.value: "auth_tokens"."target_email" IS NULL OR ("auth_tokens"."target_email" = lower(btrim("auth_tokens"."target_email")) AND position('@' in "auth_tokens"."target_email") > 1 AND "auth_tokens"."target_email" !~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]')

projection_search_ready.name: projection_search_ready
projection_search_ready.value: "persona_public_projection"."search_release_id" IS NULL OR ("persona_public_projection"."category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "persona_public_projection"."platform" IS NOT NULL AND "persona_public_projection"."origin_type" IS NOT NULL AND "persona_public_projection"."redistribution" IS NOT NULL)

release_version_valid.name: release_version_valid
release_version_valid.value: "persona_releases"."major" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999 AND "persona_releases"."minor" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999 AND "persona_releases"."patch" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999 AND "persona_releases"."version"="persona_releases"."major"::text||'.'||"persona_releases"."minor"::text||'.'||"persona_releases"."patch"::text

release_published_shape.name: release_published_shape
release_published_shape.value: ("persona_releases"."published_at" IS NULL AND "persona_releases"."approved_submission_id" IS NULL AND "persona_releases"."lifecycle"='UNPUBLISHED') OR ("persona_releases"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "persona_releases"."approved_submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "persona_releases"."lifecycle"<>'UNPUBLISHED')

import_result_consistent.name: import_result_consistent
import_result_consistent.value: ("persona_imports"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "persona_imports"."result_persona_id" IS NULL AND "persona_imports"."confirmation_hash" IS NULL) OR ("persona_imports"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "persona_imports"."result_persona_id" IS NOT NULL AND "persona_imports"."confirmation_hash" IS NOT NULL)

market_import_asset_expected_valid.name: market_import_asset_expected_valid
market_import_asset_expected_valid.value: "market_import_assets"."expected_bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND "market_import_assets"."expected_mime" IN ('image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp') AND "market_import_assets"."expected_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "market_import_assets"."storage_key" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}[.]webp$'

market_import_asset_ready_valid.name: market_import_asset_ready_valid
market_import_asset_ready_valid.value: "market_import_assets"."status"<>'ready' OR ("market_import_assets"."bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "market_import_assets"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "market_import_assets"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "market_import_assets"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "market_import_assets"."bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND "market_import_assets"."width">0 AND "market_import_assets"."height">0 AND "market_import_assets"."width"::bigint*"market_import_assets"."height"<=40000000 AND "market_import_assets"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

market_import_result_consistent.name: market_import_result_consistent
market_import_result_consistent.value: ("market_imports"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "market_imports"."result_persona_id" IS NULL AND "market_imports"."confirmation_hash" IS NULL) OR ("market_imports"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "market_imports"."result_persona_id" IS NOT NULL AND "market_imports"."confirmation_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "market_imports"."state"='ready')

ranking_board_shape.name: ranking_board_shape
ranking_board_shape.value:
"ranking_boards"."entry_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 AND "ranking_boards"."platform" IN ('all','maibot','astrbot') AND (
    ("ranking_boards"."kind"='hot' AND "ranking_boards"."window"='7d') OR ("ranking_boards"."kind"='downloads' AND "ranking_boards"."window" IN ('7d','30d','all')) OR
    ("ranking_boards"."kind"='new' AND "ranking_boards"."window"='30d') OR ("ranking_boards"."kind"='updated' AND "ranking_boards"."window"='all'))

ranking_entry_bounds.name: ranking_entry_bounds
ranking_entry_bounds.value: "ranking_entries"."position" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND "ranking_entries"."score" >= 0 AND "ranking_entries"."score" < 9007199254740992 AND "ranking_entries"."eligible_exports" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991

ranking_generation_shape.name: ranking_generation_shape
ranking_generation_shape.value:
"ranking_generations"."attempts" >= 0 AND "ranking_generations"."algorithm"='exports-v1' AND (
    ("ranking_generations"."status"='pending' AND "ranking_generations"."generated_at" IS NULL AND "ranking_generations"."error_code" IS NULL) OR
    ("ranking_generations"."status"='failed' AND "ranking_generations"."generated_at" IS NULL AND "ranking_generations"."error_code" IS NOT NULL) OR
    ("ranking_generations"."status"='completed' AND "ranking_generations"."generated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ranking_generations"."error_code" IS NULL))
